authorization.activation: Only a current explicit live plus invocation authorizes its stated scope. Installation, examples, preview and timers alone authorize no external actions.

outreach.contact_policy: One observed hiring contact per qualifying job/company; check history across sessions.
outreach.attachments_unavailable: Hold the send; do not upload a public resume workaround.

resume.policy: Only a reviewed user-supplied PDF configured locally; never a bundled example.

engage.likes_policy: Read the item and have a specific reason to agree; check whether already liked.
engage.repost_preference: Keep native attribution and add a useful original perspective.

job_focus.fit_basis: Compare essential duties and requirements with sourced profile claims; never infer location, work rights, language proficiency or employer interest.
